title: import-coverage
summary: Imports a Delphi code-coverage report (EMMA or Cobertura XML) beside the index, names records matching no routine, and feeds the ask risk chart
intro: Read this when your tests already produce a coverage report and you want to know which complex routines they leave untested. import-coverage matches the report to the indexed routines by file and routine name, stores the records next to the index, and lists everything that did not match; ask risk then ranks the routines by complexity times missing coverage.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint import-coverage --in <report.xml> --db <file.sqlite> [--json] (internal: accepted, not advertised; the EMMA reader is unverified against a real DelphiCodeCoverage report)

questions.ask: Import my coverage report so the risk chart can use it
Which complex routines do my tests leave uncovered?
